# Helvety Image Editor

> Annotate PNG, JPEG, or WebP in your browser on your device. Add text, arrows, borders, spotlight highlights, blur regions, and crop with adjustable stroke, blur, and corner radius; layers panel and zoom. No image upload to Helvety servers in the normal flow. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/image-editor): Main application route

## Crawling And Indexing
- The public image editor route is intended to be crawlable and indexable.
